info.title: Search Cancellations
info.description: Use this API to search and retrieve one or more order cancellations.

post.description: Use this API to search and retrieve one or more order cancellations.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: sort_field
parameters.description:
The returned results will be sorted by the specified field. 
**Default:** `create_time`
Possible values:
- `create_time`
- `update_time`

Specify the order for sorting the returned results by using the sort_order parameter.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description:
The sort order for the sort_field parameter. 
**Default:** `ASC`
Possible values:
- `ASC`: Ascending order
- `DESC`: Descending order

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
The number of results to be returned per page. 
**Default:** 10. 
Valid range: [1-50].

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Retrieve this value from the result of the next_page_token from a previous response. It is not needed for the first page.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

order_ids.description: List of TikTok Shop order IDs.

buyer_user_ids.description: List of TikTok Shop buyer user IDs.

cancel_types.description:
List of order cancellation types.
Possible values:
- `CANCEL`: Cancel by seller or system.
- `BUYER_CANCEL`: Cancel by buyer. Need to be approved by seller or system.

cancel_status.description:
List of order cancellation statuses.
Possible values:
- `CANCELLATION_REQUEST_PENDING`
- `CANCELLATION_REQUEST_SUCCESS`
- `CANCELLATION_REQUEST_CANCEL`
- `CANCELLATION_REQUEST_COMPLETE`

Please see "API Overview" for more information about these statuses.

create_time_ge.description: Filter cancellations to show only orders that have been created after a specified date and time. Unix timestamp.

create_time_lt.description: Filter cancellations to show only orders that have been created before a specified date and time. Unix timestamp.

update_time_ge.description: Filter cancellations to show only orders that have been updated after a specified date and time. Unix timestamp.

update_time_lt.description: Filter cancellations to show only orders that have been updated before a specified date and time. Unix timestamp.

locale.description:
The BCP-47 locale codes for displaying the order, delimited by commas. Default: en-US
Refer to [Locale codes](678e3a47bae28f030a8c7523) for the list of supported locale codes.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

order_id.description: TikTok Shop order ID. Contains multiple order line item IDs.

cancel_type.description:
Order cancellation type.
Possible values:
- `CANCEL`: Cancel by seller or system.
- `BUYER_CANCEL`: Cancel by buyer. Need to be approved by seller or system.

cancel_reason_text.description:
Order cancellation reason, localized to another language.
You can change language using the locale field in the request parameter.

create_time.description: Order cancellation create time. Unix timestamp.

update_time.description: Order cancellation update time. Unix timestamp.

action.description: **Optional.** For buyer-initiated cancellation requests that still require seller handling, the action value is `SELLER_RESPOND_CANCEL`

deadline.description: Unix timestamp indicating the deadline for when the seller must perform the next action.

refund_total.description: Total refund amount to the buyer.

refund_subtotal.description: Subtotal refund amount to the buyer.

refund_shipping_fee.description: Shipping fee refund amount to the buyer.

refund_tax.description: Tax refund amount to the buyer.

retail_delivery_fee.description: Retail delivery fee takes effect once platform GMV exceeds $500,000 USD, according to Colorado (US) compliance rules.

buyer_service_fee.description: Only for the ID market. Platform will charge the buyer a service fee depending on the scenario.

product_image.description: Product image object. Contains product image information.

cancel_sub_line_items.description:
Cancellation sub line items.
Sub items represent skus that belong to a "virtual bundle" that has been defined by a seller. The sub_items will include all relevant information about each item that is a part of the virtual bundle.

cancel_id.description: The identifier of a specific order cancellation.

should_replenish_stock.description: Should seller replenish the stock when order cancelled successfully.

total_count.description: The number of cancellations that meet the query conditions.

next_page_token.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Provide this value in the page_token parameter of your request if the current response does not return all the results.
